text: Experts often discuss the difference between narrow AI, which we use today, and artificial general intelligence (AGI). AGI would be a system with human-like abilities to learn and reason across many tasks. Its potential benefits are enormous, from solving climate change to curing diseases. However, many experts also warn about serious risks, such as mass job loss or loss of human control. Predictions for when AGI might arrive vary wildly. Some believe it is decades away, while others think it could happen within our lifetime. The future of AI is uncertain, but it will certainly shape our world.
